title: Mate on the Long Diagonal
setup: Black's king is on h1 with a pawn on c4, and your bishop on c2 is one move from the long diagonal.
hint: The bishop is one square off the line it needs. Find the move that covers g1 and g2 at once.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qf2}} takes both g1 and g2 quietly. Black must play {{c3}}, and {{Be4#}} mates on the diagonal the bishop steps onto. Zugzwang gives you the free move a mating pattern needs.
